settings.protectionHint: Even so, make a backup now and then in Data & backups.

destinations.title: Where to archive
destinations.none: You haven't chosen a folder yet.
destinations.folderHint: It can be a folder in Documents, an external drive or a USB stick. Forgetting a folder doesn't delete anything in it.
destinations.noFolders: This browser can't pick folders (common on phones). To archive, Crystal will download the files and then ask you to pick them so it can check they were saved correctly.

wizard.title: Archive files
wizard.folderHint: A folder on this device, an external drive or a USB stick. Crystal checks every copy by reading it back.
wizard.downloadHint: Works on any device. Then you pick the downloaded files and Crystal checks they're identical.
wizard.failed_one: {{count}} couldn't be copied: it stays in Crystal unchanged
wizard.failed_other: {{count}} couldn't be copied: they stay in Crystal unchanged
wizard.releaseBody: Originals with a verified copy will be removed from this device. You'll still see their thumbnail and which record they belong to, and you can recover them whenever you want.
wizard.skipped_one: {{count}} file wasn't freed because its copy isn't verified
wizard.skipped_other: {{count}} files weren't freed because their copy isn't verified
wizard.downloadedBody: Find the files in your Downloads folder (you can move them anywhere) and pick them here. Crystal will check they're identical. Until then the space can't be freed.
wizard.unknown_one: {{count}} file doesn't match any pending copy
wizard.unknown_other: {{count}} files don't match any pending copy

recoverErrors.mismatch: That file isn't the same one that was archived.
